title: Chartwise finite complex model for the coefficient layer
statement: Fix the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-finite-quotient-layer-local-complexes, a residue-model chart Z, and its bounded finite-projective complex P together with the residue comparison. Then there exists a cochain complex Q of modules over A/I^(n+2), supported in [a,b] with finite terms, whose constant realization has on Z the homology of the explicit coefficient-layer object.

source.place: Tags 0942, 094H and 094I, balancing with the annihilated ideal layer and the local algebraic model calculation.

proof.text: Choose the explicitly constructed ideal-layer tensor complex of the given residue complex. The construction theorem proves its lower and upper support bounds and finite successor-coefficient terms directly.

Apply the explicit layer tensor homology comparison using only the upper support bound and the projectivity part of the hypotheses. It supplies every required chartwise homology isomorphism. Assemble these with the proved algebraic bounds and finiteness.

theorem finiteQuotient_layer_local_complex_core
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n))
    (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d))
    (a b : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (Z : X.Etale)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1))) ℤ)
    (hPa : P.IsStrictlyGE a) (hPb : P.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hP : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1)) (P.X i) ∧
      Module.Finite (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1)) (P.X i))
    (e : Nonempty
      (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d 0)
          ((toProEt X).obj Z) ((completedAdicQuotientReduction X d 0).obj M) ≅
        ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d 0)
          ((toProEt X).obj Z) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (φ 0)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X _ P))))) :
    ∃ Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1))) ℤ,
      Q.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ Q.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1)) (Q.X i)) ∧
        ∀ q : ℤ, Nonempty
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                (finiteQuotientLayerObject X d M n)) ≅
            (SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
              ((finiteCoefficientConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1))
                (φ (n + 1))).obj (Q.homology q)))
